cases.name: number-padded-range
cases.description: A range written with leading zeros pads to that width
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="0000..9999"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-negative-range
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="-5..5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-bit
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="bit"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-digit-string
cases.description: length with no value builds a digit string one digit at a time
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" length="4" first_zero="true"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-range-list
cases.description: A list of ranges picks the range first, then the value
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="[1..3],[100..102]"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-exclude
cases.description: exclude removes a value and the draw stays uniform over what is left
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="0..9" exclude="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: number-decimals
cases.description: decimals draw over the decimal grid in one draw
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="number" value="1..2" decimals="2"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: regex-pattern
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="regex" value="[A-Z]{2}-\d{3}"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: regex-backreference
cases.description: A backreference repeats what the group actually produced
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="regex" value="([ab])-\1"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: regex-bounded-repeat
cases.description: A bounded quantifier draws its count; zero repeats is empty
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="regex" value="x{0,3}"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: advanced-regex-weighted
cases.description: A weighted choice hits its shares exactly over the column
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="advanced_regex" value="(?%{70:RU;20:US;10:DE})"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: advanced-regex-nested
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="advanced_regex" value="(?%{60:(?%{50:aa;50:ab});40:b})"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: advanced-regex-branches-are-patterns
cases.description: A branch is a full pattern, not just a literal
cases.config: <tdc><env count="10" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="advanced_regex" value="(?%{50:[0-9]{2};50:[A-Z]{2}})"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: symbol-alphabet
cases.description: symbol draws from a named alphabet
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="symbol" alphabet="latin.lower" length="3"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: symbol-exclude
cases.description: symbol excludes a character from an inline set
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="symbol" value="[a-c]" exclude="b" length="4"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: counter-increment
cases.description: increment is positional and takes no draws
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="increment" value="1000" step="5"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: counter-decrement
cases.config: <tdc><env count="5" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="decrement" value="100" step="7"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: text-percent
cases.description: percent apportions a text list exactly
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="text" value="A,B,C" percent="25,50,25"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: template-weighted-pack
cases.description: A weighted pack is laid out to its counts, not sampled
cases.config: <tdc><env count="8" seed="unit-test" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="V"><gen type="template" value="person.lastName"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{V}}</data></line></block></tdc>
